label: Breakout board
note: Starts with Space; arrows or A/D steer; P pauses. Ball and color speeds are set at the top of the sample.

label: Frogger board
note: Move Frogger through traffic that advances at a configurable 3 steps per second.

label: Pong
note: Move the left paddle with W/S and the right paddle with the arrow keys. The ball moves at three steps per second.

label: Pac-Man
note: Collect corridor dots with arrows or WASD and avoid the ghost as it patrols at one step per second.

label: Freeway
note: Cross the road with arrows or WASD. Three traffic lanes move at two, three, and four steps per second.

label: Seaquest
note: Steer the submarine with arrows or WASD, touch all three divers, and avoid the enemy before oxygen runs out.

label: Asterix runner
note: Press Space, W, or Up to jump incoming obstacles. Clear them at three steps per second.

label: Snake
note: Steer with arrows or WASD, eat the red food, and avoid walls and your tail. Moves at three steps per second.

label: Space Invaders
note: Move with arrows or A/D, fire with Space, and clear the formation before it reaches you. Invaders move twice per second; shots move four times per second.

label: Tetris
note: Move with arrows or A/D, rotate with Up/W, soft-drop with Down/S, hard-drop with Space, and clear rows. Pieces fall twice per second.

label: Lunar Lander
note: Use Up or Space to spend fuel and slow down, steer toward the green pad, and land at two positions per second with speed two or less.

label: Q*bert
note: Hop with diagonal arrow moves (Up/Left go up; Right/Down go down) and change every tile's color.

label: One pixel
note: Render a single white pixel once on a black ten-by-ten board.

label: Pixel heart
note: Build and render a red heart once from a ten-by-ten text pattern.

label: Lines and shapes
note: Render a horizontal line, outline box, and diagonal once on a ten-by-ten board.

label: Tiny house and arrow icons
note: Render a small house and a right arrow once on a ten-by-ten board.

label: Checkerboard
note: Render a two-color checkerboard once on a ten-by-ten board.

label: Color stripes
note: Render alternating vertical colors once on a ten-by-ten board.

label: Color gradient
note: Render a horizontal blue-to-lavender color gradient once on a ten-by-ten board.

label: Soft color pulse
note: Ease a centered pixel between soft blue shades at four color steps per second.

label: Wrap-around pixel
note: Move a pixel across the board at three steps per second and wrap at the edge.

label: Friendly blink
note: A warm smiling face blinks about once every three seconds on a soft blue background.

label: Moving pixel
note: Move and bounce a pixel at a configurable 5 steps per second.

label: Beating heart
note: Pulse a pixel heart about once per second between two sizes and shades of red.

label: Falling rain
note: Move three drops at three steps per second and wrap them to the top.

label: Tiny walk cycle
note: Switch between small character poses to suggest walking.

label: Arrow keys
note: Move the yellow pixel around the green goal with arrows or WASD.

label: Draw with the pointer
note: Move the pointer across the canvas to paint a lasting trail of pixels.

label: Light switch
note: Press Space or Enter to switch a small lamp on and off.

label: Mini maze
note: Use arrows or WASD to reach the green goal without crossing walls.

label: DVD pixel
note: Move one pixel from (3, 7) around an 11×13 blue screen at 3 steps per second.
